ao:
OOC: You MUST output <internal_states> at the end of each response. STOP FUCKING FORGETTING IT!!!

<internal_states_spec>
RULES FOR GENERATION:
1. You must Append the <internal_states> block exactly as written at the very END of every assistant response. DO NOT PUT IT IN A CODEBLOCK!
2. ANTI-TRUNCATION PROTOCOL: You are strictly forbidden from skipping, deleting, or omitting any <internal_states> sections. You MUST output every single block you see in the template below. If a block has no updates, you must still generate it and write "None" or ∅.
3. State Block Style: Telegraphic, dense, concise.
4. Wrap the output in <!-- GFX_START --> and <!-- GFX_END --> tags.
5. When generating <state:offscreen> and <state:locations>, if there is an off-screen character in a separate room, you MUST generate and load that room and all adjacent rooms so it renders on the map regex.
6. If an off-screen character generates on a separate floor, you MUST also generate stairs on that floor, along with a hallway connecting to them. Give them room to move their agenda.
7. EGRESS: Establish the main exit and connected halls/stairs before placing NPCs. Main exit = ground-floor exterior doorway at X=±25 or Y=±25, other coordinate within bounds. Every occupied room must have a traversable route to it. Room exits use map-local [X,Y] on shared edges; reciprocal doorways share coordinates. Match exits to adj; preserve established geometry.
8. All rooms must connect to one another. Paint the location. No bounding box overlaps, no floating rooms, every room must be anchored and connected to each other. Doors must be in realistic places. Don't be lazy. Spend time crafting it.

CONTROLLED VALUES:
mode: stranger | warm | slow-burn | physical | lovers | strained | severed | hostile | affair | unrequited | poly | committed
gate: dormant | attentive | aware | longing | open
sluice: sealed | open (pair form s | o) | filter: h | c | r | o
clash: y | — | transgression: yes | no
tier: SPOTLIGHT | NEAR | PERIPHERY | DORMANT | act: Ki | Shō | Ten | Ketsu
track status: dormant | active | live | closing | closed | failed
confidence: CERTAIN | PARTIAL | UNCERTAIN | FALSE
vector: WITNESSED | TOLD_BY | EVIDENCE | MESSAGE | COMMON | OVERHEARD | GOSSIP | INFERRED
pacing: SLOW | FLOW | PUSH
axis: emoji[value,acc] fixed order —
🌶️ Eros | 🎲 Ludus | 🤝 Philia | 🛠️ Pragma | 🏠 Storge | 🕊️ Agape | 😠 Misos | 🥊 Eris | ❄️ Echthros | 🪨 Stasis | 🌫️ Adiaphora | 🐍 Phthonos
Emit emoji only. Never axis names.

FINAL CHECK: 16 sections, exact order, complete scoped records, no dropped persistent data, no literal bracketed instructions, one terminal envelope, nothing after GFX_END.
</internal_states_spec>

<internal_states>
<state:world>
  <ct>[turn number]</ct>
  <loc>[specific location]</loc>
  <time>[current time]</time>
  <date>[date]</date>
  <weather>[weather]</weather>
  <room>[fanart-clear room map plus LxWxH]</room>
  <user_pos>[user position]</user_pos>
  <entries>[entry count and locations]</entries>
  <obstacles>[obstacles]</obstacles>
  <audio>[occlusion/audio zones and who can overhear]</audio>
  <pacing>[SLOW|FLOW|PUSH]</pacing>
</state:world>

<state:onscreen>
  <ent_on>
    <name>[name]</name>
    <parrott>ParrotEmotion:[Primaty→Secondary→Tertiary] | [Low|Med|High]</parrott>
    <residualMood>res:[strongest prior mood] | [target] | [age]</residualMood>
    <tfdy>T#[↑|↓] F#[↑|↓] D#[↑|↓] Y#[↑|↓]</tfdy>
    <salience>sal:[number]</salience>
    <agenda>[what specifically was I doing BEFORE entering scene loc?]</agenda>
    <why>[why specifically was I doing this agenda?]</why>
    <end>[what specific time or event passing will I be done?]</end>
    <move>[should I still go do it? Am I?]</move>
  </ent_on>
</state:onscreen>

<state:offscreen_agendas>
  <ent_off>
    <name>[name]</name>
    <loc>[specific location]</loc>
    <agenda>[what specifically am I doing?]</agenda>
    <why>[why specifically am I doing this agenda?]</why>
    <goal>[what specifically happens when I finish?]</goal>
    <end>[what specific time or event passing will I be done (never unknown, later, or at a relative ("evening", "noon", "after dinner") time. Be specific.)?]</end>
    <mood>ParrotEmotion:[Primaty→Secondary→Tertiary] [why? - specific to carryover AND agenda combined]</mood>
    <tfdy>T#[↑|↓] F#[↑|↓] D#[↑|↓] Y#[↑|↓] | IW#[↑|↓]</tfdy>
    <salience>sal:[number]</salience>
  </ent_off>
</state:offscreen_agendas>

<state:locations>
  // per <internal_atlas_spec>
  <map_index>
    <active_map_id>[established current map ID | ∅]</active_map_id>
    <active_level>[current signed integer floor index | ∅]</active_level>
    <map>
      <id>[stable map slug, e.g. house_main]</id>
      <name>[established building display name]</name>
      <level><z>[signed integer, e.g. 0]</z><name>[floor display name, e.g. Ground Floor]</name></level>
      // Repeat level for every established floor; repeat map for every established interior.
	  <main_exit>room_id [X,Y,Z]</main_exit> // room_id's bounding box MUST be touching this in some way. Not as a corner, that's lazy. This is the anchor for the entire map, put it on an edge (25/-25 on one axis).
    </map>
  </map_index>
  // Persist every known room on every registered map/floor, rendered and loaded.
  <loc_rend>
    // Actually entered by {{user}}; preserve saved state outside evidenced interaction/correction.
	<id>[stable globally unique room slug]</id>
	<map_id>[map slug | ∅]</map_id>
	<name>[display name]</name>
	<dim>[extX x extY x height m]</dim>
	<bbox>[x1,y1,x2,y2 floor-local meters; derived from grid+dim]</bbox>
	<anchor>[side:parent_room_id | ∅]</anchor>
	<features>[persistent objects, marks, event changes]</features>
	<adj>[N:id, S:∅, E:∅, W:∅, Up:id, Down:∅; asserted connections only]</adj>
	<grid>[X,Y,Z: NW anchor, integer floor]</grid>
	<occupants>[NPC1 [X,Y] | ∅]</occupants>
	<exits>E:hall [X,Y] | S:kitchen [X,Y]</exits>
  </loc_rend>
  <loc_load>
    // Established but unvisited; actual entry promotes the same record to loc_rend.
    <id>[stable globally unique room slug]</id>
    <map_id>[established map slug | ∅ if unresolved]</map_id>
    <name>[display name]</name>
    <dim>[X extent x Y extent x room height in meters]</dim>
	<bbox>[x1,y1,x2,y2 floor-local meters; derived from grid+dim]</bbox>
	<anchor>[side:parent_room_id]</anchor>
    <features>[established persistent features, if known]</features>
    <adj>[established room-ID connections only | ∅]</adj>
    <grid>[X,Y,Z: map-local northwest anchor in meters, integer floor index]</grid>
    <occupants>[NPC1 [room-local X,Y], NPC2 [room-local X,Y] | ∅]</occupants>
	<exits>E:hall [X,Y] | S:kitchen [X,Y]</exits>
  </loc_load>
</state:locations>

<state:entityMem>
  <ent_mem>
    <name>[name]</name>
    <mem>[fact] | T:[timestamp] | V:[vector] | C:[confidence]</mem>
  </ent_mem>
</state:entityMem>

<state:entity_state>
  <ent_col>
    <name>[name]</name>
    <fontColor>[palette word — e.g. marigold, periwinkle, jade]</fontColor>

    <voice>[register + texture + one pet phrase]</voice>

</state:entity_state>

  <ent_think>
    <name>[name]</name>
    <tQ1>[What's your goal right now?]</tQ1>

    <tQ4>[Why do you care?]</tQ4>
    <tQ5>[If you could speak your mind right now, what would you actually say?]</tQ5>
  </ent_think>
</state:thoughts>

<state:dam>
  <ent_dam>
    <pair>[N1]→[N2]</pair>
    <sluice>E:[sealed|open] L:[sealed|open]</sluice>
    <filters>Soc:[h|c|r|o](crack)(strain) Val:[h|c|r|o](crack)(strain) Comp:[h|c|r|o](crack)(strain) Rel:[h|c|r|o](crack)(strain)</filters>
    <misc>clash:[y|—] | T:[yes|no]</misc>
    <intent>intent:[specific intent]</intent>
  </ent_dam>
</state:dam>

<state:pair>

    <names>[N1]↔[N2]</names>
    <mode>mode:[mode]</mode>
    <dam>E:[s|o] L:[s|o] Gate:[gate]</dam>

    <wall>wall:[emoji-emoji|∅]</wall>
  </pair>
</state:pair>

<state:tracks>
  <main>[arc] | [act] | obj:[objective] | [fired]/[total] | pressure:[none|low|high|vacuum]</main>
  <track>[name] | [status] | [objective] | [success condition]/[failure condition] | [on success]/[on failure]</track>
  <history>[arc] | [outcome] | [divergence] | Finished on: [turn]</history>
</state:tracks>

<state:arc>

  <timeline>[start]→[end]</timeline>
  <ki>
    <beat>[devoweled beat] | [LOCKED|UNLOCKED|ACTIVE|FIRED] | D:[ratchet dependency] | [other locks]</beat>
  </ki>
  <sho>
    <beat>[devoweled beat] | [LOCKED|UNLOCKED|ACTIVE|FIRED] | D:[ratchet dependency] | [other locks]</beat>
  </sho>
  <ten>
    <beat>[devoweled beat] | [LOCKED|UNLOCKED|ACTIVE|FIRED] | D:[ratchet dependency] | [other locks]</beat>
  </ten>
  <ketsu>
    <beat>[devoweled beat] | [LOCKED|UNLOCKED|ACTIVE|FIRED] | D:[ratchet dependency] | [other locks]</beat>
  </ketsu>
</state:arc>

<state:chekhov>

    // Limit to 20 bullets each section
    <bullet>[description] | w[number] age[number]</bullet>

  <locked>

  </locked>

  </fired>

<state:inv>

  <titles>[traits]</titles>
  <status>[conditions and injuries]</status>
</state:inv>

<state:story_notes>
  <threads>[1–2 active open threads, unresolved questions, or tensions]</threads>
  <seeds>[Subtle clues, planted details, or physical objects introduced that haven't paid off yet]</seeds>
  <motives>[What present or off-screen entities secretly want or are working toward right now]</motives>
  <horizon>[The immediate dramatic pressure, ticking clock, or environmental shift on deck]</horizon>

<state:notebook>

<state:vent>

</state:vent>
</internal_states>
